This figure is a sunburst chart, a circular hierarchical diagram that categorizes various wireless communication technologies. The chart is organized into five main color-coded sectors radiating from a central black circle.

At the top right, a light blue sector labeled "LAN/PAN" occupies roughly one-third of the circle. It branches into five sub-categories:
*   "IEEE 802.15.4", which leads to the outermost labels: "ISA100.11", "Mi-Wi", "Thread", "Wireless HART", and "ZigBee".
*   "Wi-Fi", which leads to "Wi-Fi 1-5", "Wi-Fi 6/6E", and "Wi-Fi HaLow".
*   "Bluetooth", which leads to "«Обычный» Bluetooth" and "Bluetooth LE".
*   "IEEE 802.11p", which leads to "DSRC".
*   "Z-Wave", which terminates in a single outer segment also labeled "Z-Wave".

At the bottom is a green sector labeled "LPWAN". It is divided into two primary sub-categories:
*   "Несотовые LPWAN", branching into "Wi-SUN", "Weightless", "XNB", "SigFox", "NB-Fi", "LoRaWAN", and "DASH7".
*   "Сотовые LPWAN", which is distinguished by orange diagonal hatching. This sub-category contains the labels "EC-GSM-IoT", "eMTC - LTE Cat. M1/2", "NB-IoT - LTE Cat. NB1/2", and "LTE Cat 1/1 bis".

To the left is an orange sector labeled "Сотовая связь". It shares the hatched "Сотовые LPWAN" sub-category with the green sector. Its other sub-categories include:
*   "2G", leading to "EDGE", "GPRS", and "2G GSM".
*   "5G", leading to "Неавтономные сети 5G - 5G NSA" and "Автономные сети 5G - 5G SA".
*   "4G/LTE", leading to "4G/LTE-A, LTE-A Pro".
*   "3G", leading to "3G UMTS".

At the top left is a red sector labeled "Спутниковая связь", divided into two sub-categories:
*   "Direct to Satellite IoT - DSTIoT", leading to "Низкоорб. спутники - LEO".
*   "Сервис трансп. сети IoT - Backhaul", leading to "Среднеорб. и геостац. спутники - MEO и GEO".

A narrow dark blue segment labeled "RFID" sits between the red and blue sectors, containing two outer segments: "Активные метки RFID" and "Активные сенсоры RFID".
